This is an AR Provision Forecast Model for Mindware FY 2026.
It tracks ~2,850 customers and calculates monthly bad debt provisions.
1. Forecast provision requirements at each month-end
2. Track impact of collections on reducing provisions
4. Support financial planning and P&L forecasting
RULE 1: AR DATA DATE (Cell B5) - THE MASTER CONTROL
- This date determines which month is active (first month AFTER this date)
- All months ON or BEFORE this date return 0 (inactive)
- The model is FULLY DYNAMIC - changing B5 adjusts all formulas automatically
- Example: If B5 = 31-May-2026, then June is the active month
- Column G contains the Main Account code
- All provision formulas check IF(G=12301) before calculating
RULE 3: AGING SHIFT - 30 DAYS PER MONTH
- Each month after AR Data Date, all aging buckets shift forward by 30 days
- This increases provision rates as time passes without collection
- The shift is DYNAMIC based on months elapsed from B5
- Example: Not Due (3%) becomes 1-30 days (3%) after 1 month
- After 3 months, Not Due shifts to 61-90 days (25% rate)
- Collections in FIFO columns are allocated to OLDEST buckets first
- Users can manually allocate collections to SPECIFIC aging buckets
- Use when you know exactly which invoices will be collected
- WARNING: Do NOT use both FIFO and Specific for same customer
- Each months provision considers ALL prior active month collections
- July provision = AR reduced by June + July collections
- Collections only count if their month is AFTER the AR Data Date
- Insured portion is provisioned at only 5% of standard rate (95% reduction)
- Formula: Provision x (1 - MIN(1, Insurance/Expected_AR) x 0.95)
- Represents advance payments or credits on account
- Applied via FIFO to reduce aging buckets before calculating provision
Column U - Provision without any collection:
- Uses only On Account (J) to reduce buckets via FIFO
- Uses On Account + ACTIVE MONTH FIFO collection (dynamic)
- Collection column changes based on B5 date
Column W - Provision after collection including Insurance:
- Same as V but applies 95% insurance reduction on insured portion
- Uses CHOOSE(MONTH($B$5)+1,...) to pick active month collection
- Calculates W - S (current vs prior provision)
Monthly Provision FC Columns (CB, CM, CX, DI, DT, EE, EP, FA):
- Applies CUMULATIVE collections from all prior active months
- Applies dynamic aging shift based on months elapsed from B5
- Applies insurance factor (95% reduction on insured portion)
- Returns 0 if month is on or before AR Data Date
Monthly Provision Effect Columns (CA, CL, CW, DH, DS, ED, EO, EZ):
- Shows total difference from current provision for each month
Monthly Expected AR Columns (BZ, CK, CV, DG, DR, EC, EN, EY):
- AR Balance (R) - Cumulative active month collections
- Only subtracts collections from months AFTER AR Data Date
